confidence_definition.separation: mean selected prediction minus mean comparison prediction
confidence_definition.agreement: mean fraction of 15 family-seed members having the ensemble prediction sign among selected assets
confidence_definition.disagreement: mean member standard deviation plus mean family standard deviation among selected assets
confidence_definition.raw_score: separation times agreement divided by max(disagreement, denominator_floor)

causal_tiers.threshold_source: expanding distribution of raw confidence scores strictly before the current decision

risk_guards.information_available: ML sleeve returns realized no later than the current decision

accounting.rebalance: monthly at the source model decision
accounting.allocation_turnover: absolute change in ML sleeve weight
accounting.sleeve_costs: each underlying sleeve retains its own simulated trading costs; cross-sleeve netting is not assumed

promotion_gates.annual_return_10bps: greater than frozen core on the common period
promotion_gates.sharpe_10bps: greater than frozen core on the common period
promotion_gates.maximum_drawdown_10bps: no worse than frozen core on the common period
promotion_gates.confidence_calibration: higher-confidence decisions have greater mean future rank IC than inactive decisions and positive mean future rank IC
